description: This file defines interfaces, enums, and function prototypes for intercepting and managing operations on ANativeWindow objects in Android native development. It includes function pointer typedefs for buffer operations, interceptors registration functions, and utility functions related to buffer timing.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setCancelBufferInterceptor
methods.description: Registers an interceptor for cancelBuffer operations on an ANativeWindow object.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setDequeueBufferInterceptor
methods.description: Registers an interceptor for dequeueBuffer operations on an ANativeWindow object.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setPerformInterceptor
methods.description: Registers an interceptor for perform operations on an ANativeWindow object.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setQueueBufferInterceptor
methods.description: Registers an interceptor for queueBuffer operations on an ANativeWindow object.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_getLastDequeueDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration in nanoseconds of the last buffer dequeue operation.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_getLastQueueDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration in nanoseconds of the last buffer queue operation.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_getLastDequeueStartTime
methods.description: Returns the system time in nanoseconds when the last buffer dequeue started.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setDequeueTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout in nanoseconds for buffer dequeue operations.
